messages:
natalie: FYI ran the nightly vault audit and surfaced ~18 ciphertext entries whose metadata.key_id points to a retired KMS key. A couple of services reported transient decrypt errors this morning. No obvious outbound anomaly but we should triage. :eyes:

omar: Can you paste one of the errors and which mounts/paths are affected?

natalie: Sample error from vault logs: `error="transit: decrypt failed: kms:InvalidCiphertext" metadata.key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222222:key/retired-KEY-zzz path=secret/data/serviceY/db`. Paths clustered under `secret/data/serviceY` and `secret/data/partner-ingest/*`. I also uploaded a quick listing to s3://sec-audit/vault-key-id-scan/1751001111.json

priya: Noted. Partner-ingest still uses their onboarding key; looks like we never enforced key rotation in their role. That's an onboarding/RBAC gap.

dan: Immediate actions I propose: 1) block further Encrypt/GenerateDataKey by partner role on retired-KEY-zzz (IAM deny) 2) snapshot affected vault entries 3) dry-run re-encrypt to new key in staging 4) perform prod re-encrypt via ephemeral identity.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1751001111 (sev2) — tag `vault-kms-mismatch`. Add owners and timeline.

oncall-bot: Prod re-encrypt requires oncall approval to run job as ephemeral account. Requester: dan. Approve with `/oncall approve 1h` or escalate.

dan: I'll take run ownership. Plan details: - create role `ephemeral/rewrap-runner` with 1h STS session, require `sts:AssumeRole` + mfa - grant kms:ReEncrypt on new-key (current-KEY-aaa) and kms:Decrypt on retired-KEY-zzz for that role only - ensure Vault audit logging enabled and CloudTrail logs routed to sec-logs bucket - snapshot vault to s3://vault-backups/pre-rewrap-1751001111 (encrypted)

priya: Also add a short-lived allowlist for allowed key ARNs in Vault config so new ciphertexts get rejected if not using allowed keys. We'll fail-safe writes during remediation.

omar: How are we finding all affected ciphertexts? I ran this query: 
```bash
vault kv metadata list secret | xargs -I{} sh -c "vault kv get -format=json secret/{} | jq '.data.data | select(.ciphertext != null)'")
```
but can we pull metadata.key_id via transit/ciphertexts endpoint?

natalie: I used the transit admin endpoint and grepped: `vault list transit/keys/kv-prod/ciphertexts | xargs -n1 vault read transit/ciphertexts/{} | jq .metadata.key_id` — gave the key_id field quickly.

dan: Dry-run plan in staging: run `vault operator rewrap -dry-run` against the set, verify no TTL/replay issues, run smoke tests (DB connections, service Y health). Mark each record with `meta.rewrap_run=1751001111` if successful.

priya: Partner notification: I'll ping partner slack and the partner-security mailing list. Ask them to stop writes to ingest endpoint until we confirm their key rotation. Also request proof of key rotation on their side.

oncall-bot: Approval: /oncall approve 1h received from maya. Job allowed to run.

dan: Starting staging dry-run now. Will log stdout to s3 and link here. JobID: rewrap-stage-1751001111.

natalie: Staging dry-run passed. Two ciphertexts had TTL expiry warnings; we need to refresh those clients.

dan: Proceeding with production re-encrypt. Snapshot taken (vault-backups/pre-rewrap-1751001111), CloudTrail markers in place. Running re-encrypt in batches of 50.

security-bot: Alert: unwrap_error_count dropped to baseline after first batch. Monitoring set to check unwrap errors for 60m.

dan: Prod re-encrypt finished. 17/18 blobs re-encrypted successfully; 1 blob failed due to a client-side keywrap that needs partner intervention. We isolated that record: secret/data/partner-ingest/legacy-token. I left it untouched and flagged partner to rotate.

priya: I revoked partner's legacy encrypt permissions on retired-KEY-zzz and created PR to patch onboarding docs to require rotation within 48h. PR: https://git.internal/docs/pulls/122

omar: Followups: - run weekly scan job that compares ciphertext metadata.key_id vs approved keyset - add IAM linter rule: fail CI if role policies include kms:Encrypt for deprecated keys - add vault audit alert when new ciphertext uses non-allowed key - document runbook for ephemeral rewrap procedure.

natalie: I've uploaded runbook + snapshot manifest to https://docs.internal/sec/vault/rewrap/1751001111 and annotated the one failed blob.

dan: I rotated runtime DB creds referenced by serviceY and redeployed; services healthy. Closing incident but keeping the incident channel open for 24h monitoring.

priya: Postmortem owners: priya -> partner onboarding checklist (48h), omar -> CI IAM linter (2w), natalie -> weekly scan job (1w), dan -> finalize runbook and tooling (3d).

natalie: Thanks team. Small win but let's get the preventive guardrails in place. :white_check_mark:
